about: Get a Dubai birth certificate for a newborn, or a copy or replacement of one.
note: Requirements read from the official DHA service page on the checked date. DHA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to citizens, residents and visitors
Copies and replacements are applied for by the father or mother
documents: For a new certificate, originals of both parents' Emirates ID or passport
Marriage certificate, authenticated if issued abroad
Birth notification stamped by the hospital
For a replacement, both parents' ID copies and a police letter if no copy of the lost certificate exists
For a copy, a copy of the certificate and both parents' ID copies
